true_write_boundary.deferred_until: WebEnvoy #409 current-main packaged live evidence for both action identities and later independent authorization checks

must_reject_if: action_id is missing, unknown, or does not match requested_path
Core cannot bind one single-action authorization decision to the exact action and target
Core cannot bind one TaskTurnRecord idempotency key to the exact action and target
required Harbor page/control/identity fact is absent, stale, or mismatched
operation result or external effect is unknown and a success claim is requested
post-check or reconciliation ref is absent
save_draft, publish, submit, retry, or bypass is requested
the action would store media bytes, user content, or private runtime material

consumer_boundary: Lode declares the proposed action contract and blocks package admission. Core owns authorization, idempotency, operation lifecycle and result envelope; Harbor owns live execution/evidence; App renders refs-only state.
source_decisions: #307 requires upload and text-to-image generation to remain separate actions with separate external-effect declarations.
#409 supplies the first formal packaged live consumer and must prove both paths before lifecycle promotion.
#412/#295 own later field writing, save-draft and publish contracts independently.
non_goals: No browser execution or live admission from this static guardrail.
No save draft, publish, submit, retry, or bypass behavior.
No copied Core run lifecycle, authorization record, idempotency key, or raw evidence.
